desc:
🧩 Can you put the character back together faster than your opponent?

Every round you get a famous character cut into puzzle pieces — eyes, ears, mouths and all. Drag them into place, lock in, and beat the other player before the timer runs out! Lose a round and you lose a heart. Lose all 3 and you're OUT! 💥

🏆 Win the match and take the cash prize rolled at the start — up to $100,000!
🪑 Collect 50+ chairs — Common to Legendary — each one multiplies your cash
🎁 Daily rewards, playtime gifts and daily quests
🤖 Play a Bot in Speed Mode, or practice solo
😈 Troll your opponent: blind them, reset their board, or steal a peek!
🔥 Hard Mode for the real pros

👍 Join the group for a FREE exclusive Upside Down Chair!
🔔 Favorite for updates — new characters added all the time!
